verses.pali: “Nāhaṁ, bhikkhave, aññaṁ ekarasampi samanupassāmi yaṁ evaṁ itthiyā cittaṁ pariyādāya tiṭṭhati yathayidaṁ, bhikkhave, purisaraso.
verses.english: “Mendicants, I do not see a single taste that occupies a woman’s mind like the taste of a man.

verses.pali: Purisaraso, bhikkhave, itthiyā cittaṁ pariyādāya tiṭṭhatī”ti.
verses.english: The taste of a man occupies a woman’s mind.”
